# add lens

Add the `lens` cask — Lens, a desktop IDE for Kubernetes clusters — to the Homebrew toolset next to the command-line Kubernetes tools (`kubernetes-cli`, `kubectx`, `minikube`). The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/lens).
